items.headline: First pitch tonight — the smallest-market World Series ever opens in Milwaukee
items.body: The Rays and Brewers get the Fall Classic going tonight (8 ET on FOX) in Milwaukee. Milwaukee hands the ball to flamethrowing rookie Jacob Misiorowski — who's already touched 104.8 mph this October — against Tampa Bay's red-hot Drew Rasmussen, unbeaten since the All-Star break.
items.say: Did you see who's starting Game 1 for the Brewers? A rookie who throws 104 mph. This World Series could get wild.

items.headline: DC goes full body-horror — 'Clayface' oozes into theaters today
items.body: James Gunn's DC rolls the dice on a straight-up horror movie: a washed-up actor takes an experimental treatment and starts literally falling apart. Mike Flanagan co-wrote it, and the early reviews are surprisingly warm — around 75% on Rotten Tomatoes.
items.say: A DC movie that's actual body horror just opened — supposedly gross in the best way. Are you a horror person?

items.headline: BLACKPINK's LISA drops her 'PRESS PLAY' EP
items.body: Lisa's new solo EP PRESS PLAY lands today. Its lead single 'SaWaDiKa' — a vibrant love letter to her hometown of Bangkok — already blew past 200 million views, so expect the rest of the project to be everywhere this weekend.
items.say: LISA's new EP is out — that 'SaWaDiKa' video already hit 200 million views. Are you into K-pop at all?

items.headline: 'Lupin' is back — all of Part 4 just hit Netflix
items.body: Omar Sy returns as gentleman thief Assane Diop, and all eight episodes of Part 4 dropped today. It picks up four years later with Assane behind bars — prime weekend-binge material if you loved the first run.
items.say: New Lupin dropped on Netflix today — the whole season at once. Perfect weekend binge, right?

items.headline: London derby headlines a loaded Saturday — Chelsea host Tottenham
items.body: Premier League weekend is stacked: Chelsea–Spurs at Stamford Bridge, plus Arsenal–Everton and Aston Villa–Man City all on Saturday. The last time these two London rivals met, Chelsea edged it 2-1.
items.say: Chelsea-Spurs this weekend — that one's always chaos. Who've you got in the London derby?

items.headline: Worlds gets real — the Swiss Stage kicks off with Korea-vs-China clashes
items.body: The League of Legends World Championship hits its Swiss Stage in Texas today, and Round 1 is loaded with heavyweight LCK-LPL bouts — Gen.G vs Invictus Gaming and Hanwha Life vs Top Esports headline. Win three and you're into the knockouts; lose three and you're out.
items.say: LoL Worlds just hit the real bracket — Korea vs China on day one. Do you follow any esports?

items.headline: Guitar wizards Polyphia return with 'Be Not Afraid'
items.body: Instrumental-rock phenoms Polyphia dropped their fifth album, Be Not Afraid, today. The single 'Power in the Blood' — shot in a gold-leaf Baroque church in Rio — shows off the jaw-dropping fretwork that's made them a cult favorite, no singing required.
items.say: If you've never heard Polyphia, their new album's out — unreal guitar playing and not a single lyric. Worth a listen.

items.headline: Big Noon bounce-back — Indiana heads to Michigan on Saturday
items.body: Fresh off having their long win streak snapped, Indiana hits the road for a Big Ten showdown at Michigan in the noon window on FOX. The Big House is a brutal place to rebound, so this one should have some bite.
items.say: Indiana at Michigan Saturday at noon — big Big Ten one. You catching any college football this weekend?
